The two m144 loading cells both had V1 overpredicted and did not show a comparably large loading displacement, weakening a universal loading correction. m208 was overpredicted at 1/1, m203 had V1 below prediction but V2 above the measured value, and m51 remained more delayed than predicted. The batch therefore emphasizes matched N, donor, loading, and carbonyl contrasts while retaining four donor-free controls.","batch_rationale":"The batch uses five fixed-loading nitrogen ratio cells to repair heteroaromatic transitions, ten high-width tail candidates to distinguish ratio effects from loading-solvent switches, and eight donor/loading cells to resolve geometry-specific adsorption. Four compact heavy-atom or hydrophobic controls constrain the correction field. These complementary labels should improve V1 and V2 generalization across both ordinary compact rows and the smaller set of high-loss delayed rows in the Row-distribution."}
